hero.title: Vote on what ships next
hero.lede: This is the whole Ledgerline build queue, in the open — what's in progress now, what's queued next, and what's still on the horizon. Tap the pill on any card to vote it up; tap again to take your vote back.
hero.noteTitle: Before you vote — the honest bit
hero.note: Votes are saved in your browser, on this device only. No account, nothing sent anywhere. Each count is the baseline we published with the last board update, plus your own vote — an indicator of interest, not a live tally.

steps.title: Vote from this device
steps.body: Tap the vote pill on any card. Your vote lands in this browser's local storage — nothing is sent to a server and there is no account to create. Tap again to un-vote.

steps.title: Counts are indicative
steps.body: Every card shows the baseline count from our last published board update, plus your own vote on top. Two people can see slightly different numbers — it's a signal of interest, not a live synced tally.

steps.title: Make it count
steps.body: Your on-device vote is a private marker of what matters to you. To move the published numbers, send us a quick email — we tally emails and support requests every time we refresh the board.

items.question: Do I need an account to vote?
items.answer: No. Votes are stored in your browser's local storage, on this device only. Nothing is sent to a server, there is nothing to sign up for, and clearing this site's data resets your votes.

items.question: Are the vote counts a live tally?
items.answer: No — and we'd rather be straight about it. Each count is an indicative baseline we set when we publish a board update, plus your own on-device vote. Someone else looking at this page right now may see slightly different numbers.

items.question: How does my vote reach the team, then?
items.answer: By itself it doesn't leave your device — it's a private marker of what matters to you. If you want to move the published numbers, email us the feature name. We tally emails and support conversations whenever we refresh the board.

items.question: How often does the board change?
items.answer: After every planning cycle — usually every few weeks. Items move from Later to Next as they get scoped, into Now when we start building, and out of the board into release notes when they ship.

items.question: Can I suggest something that isn't on the board?
items.answer: Please do. The suggest button opens a pre-filled email — describe the job you're trying to get done rather than a feature spec. That's the most useful shape of feedback for us.
